en.headline: Festival of Connoisseurs debuts at AsiaWorld-Expo as first government-funded international flagship
en.dek: Informa Markets said the 4-6 November event covers superyachts, supercars, fine jewellery and more, with linked public experiences on Victoria Harbour and Lantau.
body: Informa Markets announced that The Festival of Connoisseurs will make its debut from 4 to 6 November at AsiaWorld-Expo, as the first international flagship exhibition supported by government funding under a scheme to attract large-scale events with new elements.

The exhibition focuses on premium lifestyle themes including superyachts, supercars, fine jewellery and watches, private aviation, premium travel and fine art. Under a city-as-your-showroom concept, it links indoor showcases with Victoria Harbour and waterfront experiences.

Three linked public events run from 1 to 8 November: a free Victoria Harbour cruise from Central Pier No. 10 on 1 November, a free outdoor Marina Showcase at the main exhibition, and a free boat show at Lantau Yacht Club from 6 to 8 November. Main-show admission is ticketed and requires advance registration. Organisers said the event aims to bring high-spending visitors and support Hong Kong’s convention sector.

zh.headline: 鑑賞家節於亞洲國際博覽館首次舉辦　為政府資助國際旗艦展覽
zh.dek: Informa Markets指，11月4至6日活動涵蓋超級遊艇、超跑車及名貴首飾等，並有維多利亞港及大嶼山的公眾體驗環節。
body: Informa Markets宣佈，「鑑賞家節」將於11月4至6日在亞洲國際博覽館首次舉辦，是政府資助吸引具新元素大型國際展覽計劃下的首個國際旗艦展覽。
展覽專注高端生活方式，涵蓋超級遊艇、超跑車、名貴首飾及腕錶、私人航空、高端旅遊及美術等主題。採用「城市即展場」概念，把室內展覽與維多利亞港及海濱體驗連結。
1月至8日有三項連環公眾活動：11月1日中環十號碼頭免費維多利亞港遊艇、主展覽外免費遊艇展示區，以及11月6至8日大嶼山遊艇會免費船展。主展覽需預先登記及購票入場。主辦方指，活動旨在帶來高消費遊客並支持香港會展業。
